description:
Birth year from an age, or birth date window from a date of death.

    Use for: 'what year was I born if I am 30', 'birth year calculator',
    'how old in what year', 'born when if died aged 72', 'headstone age birth year'.

    Birthday passed: this year minus age; still to come: one year earlier. A birthday
    today counts as passed. Died 15 March 2020 aged 72: born 16 March 1947 to
    15 March 1948. Today is New Zealand's date.

    Args:
        age: Completed years, now or at death.
        birthday_passed: Has the birthday happened this year?
        birthday_month: Birthday month, instead of birthday_passed.
        birthday_day: Birthday day, with birthday_month.
        date_of_death: YYYY-MM-DD, for the birth date window.
        as_at: YYYY-MM-DD instead of today.

    Returns:
        The birth year or both candidates, and the earliest and latest birth dates.
name: birth_year_calculator
